title: 云是怎么来的
subtitle: 水变成小水珠挂在天上
character: wearing a pale blue hoodie, white shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel with powdery blended strokes and visible chalk texture, sky blue, cloud white and warm apricot

pages.zh:
天上飘着一团白的，
软软的，像棉花糖。
我问爸爸：
能拿下来
咬一口吗？
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy lying back on grass and looking up, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, wondering, with big white clouds in a blue sky filling the whole picture behind him right out to all four edges.

pages.zh:
爸爸说那不能吃。
天上那团白，
既不是棉花，
也不是烟，
它是水变出来的。

太阳晒着地上的水，
水洼、河，还有海。
水被晒得暖了，
就悄悄变成气，
偷偷往上跑。
pages.scene: Warm sunlight falling on a wide shallow puddle on bare ground, faint wisps of vapour rising from it, and a bright blue sky filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
变成气的水
我们看不见。
它就在身边，
在你吸进去的
每一口空气里。

越往上越冷。
升到高处的水汽
冷得受不了，
只好又变回水，
变成小水珠。
pages.scene: A tall column of open sky filling the whole picture right out to all four edges, warm and hazy near the bottom and cold pale blue near the top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
变的时候
它得先找个芯。
空气里飘着灰尘，
一粒灰尘
就够一颗水珠抱住。

一颗水珠有多小？
比一根头发
还要细得多。
几百颗排起来，
才有头发那么宽。

一颗看不见，
十颗也看不见。
可等到几千亿颗
挤在一块儿，
我们就看见白了。

那就是云。
它不是一整块，
是数不清的小水珠，
各自飘着，
凑成了一团。
pages.scene: Great white cumulus clouds piled high in a blue sky that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges, seen from below. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以云摸不着。
飞机从里面穿过去，
窗外只是一片灰白，
再没有别的——
就像穿过一阵湿气。
pages.scene: A great white cloud filling the whole picture right out to all four edges, one small aeroplane flying into it and everything around it pale grey white. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水珠碰上水珠，
越碰越大，
大到托不住了，
就往下掉。
掉下来的，就是雨。

我又抬头看了看。
那不是棉花糖，
那是好多好多
小得看不见的水珠，
挤在一起在天上走。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy standing in a field at dusk and pointing up, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, happy, with the evening sky filling the whole picture behind him right out to all four edges.
